caption:
Your best ad is already written. It's sitting in your 5-star reviews.

Business owners describe their service like a brochure: "quality work, professional team, competitive prices."

Customers describe it like a story: "he showed up the same day, fixed what two other guys couldn't, and cleaned up better than he found it."

Guess which one makes the next customer call.

Marketers call this voice of customer. How to use it today:
→ Read your last 30 reviews
→ Highlight the exact phrases that repeat
→ Use them word for word as headlines, hooks and captions

Your customers already wrote your copy. You just haven't copied it yet.

📌 Send this to a business owner with great reviews and boring ads.
